question: Should Telegram expose standalone `pin` and `unpin` message-tool actions, and what gate plus target semantics should protect them?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but exposing these actions grants persistent Telegram pinned-message mutation through configured bot credentials, and the current config has no pin-specific policy gate or approved implicit-unpin contract.

options.title: Approve gated explicit actions
options.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind an explicit gate, require `messageId` unless maintainers approve an implicit unpin mode, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep delivery pin only
options.body: Do not expose standalone pin/unpin actions yet; keep only the existing delivery-pin path for messages OpenClaw just sent.

options.title: Request design first
options.body: Ask for a short design covering admin-right expectations, per-account gating, implicit unpin behavior, and forum-topic semantics before implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve gated explicit actions
recommendation.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind an explicit gate, require `messageId` unless maintainers approve an implicit unpin mode, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The product/security choice extends the shared message action discovery and dispatch seam that gumadeiras recently consolidated.
